title: Answering for your office, and resigning it

producer.writes: A governing.office-consequence event that closes a term when the officeholder resigns.
producer.runsDetail: The press desk offers the five answers (explain, stand by your account, cooperate, decline, resign) when a finding names the player: PressDeskPanel.tsx:403 calls answerForOfficeOnDesk, which writes through recordOfficeConsequence.

readers.reads: Honors a resignation when naming who holds a state office. It filters on an event type nothing in play writes, so it never matches.
